question: How does this approach compares to the state-of-the-art results on these tasks?
title: Contextual Joint Factor Acoustic Embeddings
answer_short: The CJFA encoder performs significantly better in both phone classification and speaker recognition tasks compared with other approaches, with up to 3% relative gain on phone classification and 3–6% gain on speaker recognition.
answer_rationale: The CJFA encoder outperforms both the VAE baseline and the CJFS encoder in both phone classification and speaker recognition tasks, as stated in the results section. The CJFA encoder achieves a relative gain of up to 3% on phone classification and 3–6% on speaker recognition, indicating superior performance compared to state-of-the-art results at the time of the study.
